note: A test for a property that holds BY CONSTRUCTION needs a positive-control arm, or it is a comment. The Grain wrote H5 (aggregating room water over a canonical cell reproduces the cell water kind) as a tripwire for a future mechanism. First draft sampled a radius-4 BFS patch per cell and its control arm found 0 violations of 44 cells -- across 1/132 of a cell a three-corner blend moves ~2%, so the scan could not see what it existed to catch. Re-sampled as a fan across the whole cell (t=0.04..0.32 toward each neighbour, plus a small off-lattice third component): conserves 80/80 cells, 2151 rooms, while the reverted mechanism breaks the aggregate on 11 and unanimity on 27. Two hazards it had to route around: RoomAddr::containing degenerates at a cell CENTRE (exact room-lattice corner -> middle-child fallback -> ~5 deg off, weights 64/64/64) AND on the arc between two centres (exact edge path), so a two-point mix reproduces the trap instead of avoiding it.
